residual_risks: All five committed browser projects use Chromium, including the iPhone/iPad device descriptors; passing this matrix cannot establish Safari/WebKit, physical safe-area/browser-bar behavior, thumb comfort, child usability, or mobile frame-rate/memory acceptance.

The rotation pixel assertions require more than 40 matching attacker and defender pixels in selected bands after a separately rendered status label. They detect disappearance of the primary combatants but do not prove full silhouette/effect containment or animation aesthetics throughout the timeline; shared-coordinate unit checks and visual acceptance remain complementary evidence.
testing_gaps: The new responsive GameUI status layout is exercised with normal turn banners, while browser promotion selection/cancellation and long check/checkmate banners remain untested. docs/TEST_PLAN.md explicitly retains those phone interaction and visual acceptance gates.

e2e/mobile.spec.js enables Instant and reduced motion together, so its capture bypasses the presenter. The browser suite does not establish a real animated reduced-motion or Fast capture across rotation; FireDragonPresenter unit tests only establish selected reduced-motion effects and callback behavior.

AttackDirector's changed skip/finishCleanup paths catch presenter exceptions, but no unit scenario makes presenter.skip or presenter.cleanup throw and verifies exact-once commitment/cancellation plus released input. Current normal and stale-callback tests cover the successful cleanup paths.
